column3: Description

Develop features to turn provider management into a comprehensive workforce product. This includes schedule editing, capacity limits, service assignments, provider dashboards, and enhanced provider profiles.
Create a schedule editor UI for providers and admins to manage individual provider availability, including breaks, PTO, blackout dates, recurring patterns, and exceptions.
Add functionality to define daily/weekly booking caps, buffer times, and maximum concurrent appointments per provider to prevent overbooking.
Introduce a configuration layer where services can be assigned to providers and skills tracked. Expose these assignments in the booking flow for intelligent routing.
Deliver personalized dashboards for providers showing upcoming appointments, client details, and performance metrics. Ensure mobile-friendly access.
Enhance provider profiles with photos, biographies, specialties, ratings, and completion scores. Make key profile fields customer-facing in the booking flow.
Expand the booking journey into a conversion-optimized funnel. Include provider choice, upsells, payments, self-service changes, advanced intake forms, and hold recovery.
Allow customers to choose a preferred provider or first available during booking. Provide filters based on service, location, or rating.
Enable add-on services and product upsells in the booking flow. Support bundling and cross-selling with configurable options.
Integrate payment processing to collect deposits or full payments at booking. Support configurable deposit rules per service/provider.
Allow customers to cancel or reschedule appointments within defined windows, handling fees and refund logic as configured.
Provide customizable intake forms with conditional fields to collect client preferences, medical history, or project details during booking.
Track booking holds that expire without confirmation. Send reminders or incentives to encourage conversion and report on hold-to-confirm rates.
Grow TillyCRM from basic client records into a retention-focused toolkit with segmentation, insights, loyalty, follow-ups, and messaging.
Extend client records with tags, preferences and behavioral segments (frequent, lapsed, VIP) to enable targeted outreach.
Calculate visit frequency, time since last visit, and lifetime value. Display these metrics and trigger follow-ups when clients lapse.
Store a client’s no-show and cancellation patterns. Use this data to require deposits or send additional reminders.
Implement points or membership-based rewards for repeat bookings, product purchases, and referrals. Integrate loyalty status into booking flows.
Create templated email and SMS sequences for post-visit thank-yous, review requests, and win-back offers for lapsed clients.
Provide a unified inbox for staff to send and receive messages via SMS/email and store conversation threads in client profiles.
Make multi-business membership a first-class experience with intuitive switching, cross-business dashboards, and provider portfolios.
Design a user interface to switch between businesses easily. Include context indicators and quick access to each business’s dashboard.
Provide aggregated dashboards for providers or admins across multiple businesses, showing appointments, earnings, and notifications.
Create a profile page showing a provider’s affiliations, ratings, and availability across businesses to support network and marketplace scenarios.
Harden communication capabilities into a channel strategy with email support, preferences, logs, campaigns, and compliance.
Expose email settings in business settings. Allow businesses to enable email confirmations/reminders and manage customizable templates.
Allow clients to set preferred channels (SMS, email or both) and implement fallback logic if the primary channel fails.
Build a log viewer to audit outbound SMS and email messages with delivery statuses and search/filter functionality.
Enable one-off messages or campaign sends to selected client segments with scheduling, templating, and analytics.
Ensure communication features comply with regulations such as TCPA and GDPR. Track client consent and provide unsubscribe options.
Add comprehensive reporting and analytics capabilities covering utilization, conversion, retention, revenue proxies, no-show metrics, and data export.
Create dashboards showing appointment volumes by day, provider, service, and location. Highlight idle time and utilization percentages.
Analyze funnel steps from page views to bookings, holds, confirmations, and cancellations. Identify drop-off points and optimize the booking journey.
Track repeat booking rates, average time between visits, and client lifetime value. Provide cohort analysis to measure retention over time.
Estimate revenue by combining service durations with pricing data and later integrate actual payment data to understand revenue mix.
Create reports quantifying missed appointments by provider, service, and date range. Use insights to refine deposit and reminder policies.
Provide export capabilities and APIs to connect analytics data to external BI tools for deeper analysis.
Integrate AI-driven capabilities into scheduling and client management to optimize operations and improve retention.
Use predictive analytics and machine learning to recommend optimal provider schedules based on historical booking patterns and seasonal trends.
Develop models to identify clients at risk of no-showing or lapsing. Trigger proactive reminders or win-back campaigns based on risk scores.
Implement logic to recommend the best provider for each booking based on availability, skills, and client preferences. Allow client override.
Offer AI-driven suggestions to clients during booking (e.g., next best slot, alternative provider) to increase conversions and reduce schedule gaps.
Provide data-driven feedback to providers on utilization, rebooking rates, and client satisfaction to support continuous improvement.
